name: Senjou de Shoujo wa Karada o Kakeru - Dark Side
original_name: 戦場デ少女ハ躰ヲカケル Dark Side
source:
Dark Side is an if scenario released only as a privilege through mail order.
It asks what would have happened "if" Nicolette had destroyed Sean's unit when he was away, forcing him to start over with new recruits.
translation:
《黑暗面》是一个仅通过邮购作为特权发布的场景。
它询问“如果”尼科莱特在肖恩离开时摧毁了他的部队，迫使他重新招募新兵，会发生什么。
